{{Quote|The island is not terribly large&mdash;though it is the biggest in the inhabitable archipelago which forms much of Boztrok spaceport.|[[TriNebulon News/Legends|TriNebulon News]] report by [[Andor Javin]]|<ref name="Galaxywide NewsNets">{{JournalCite|13|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>}}
'''Boztrok starport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]<ref name="J11">{{JournalCite|11|Smuggler's Log}}</ref> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Boztrok system/Legends|Boztrok system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Boztrok]]. Run by [[Pok Nar-Ten]] on behalf of the [[Klatooinian Trade Guild/Legends|Klatooinian Trade Guild]], the starport consisted of seven [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]], three technical hangars, and a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="J11" />
